payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about state-of-the-art baselines in the context of text-to-SQL generation, including comparisons with existing models and their performance metrics.

claims.text: State-of-the-art baselines include Context-dependent Seq2Seq (CD-Seq2Seq) and SyntaxSQL-con, which are adapted for context-dependent SQL generation.
Recent models achieving state-of-the-art performance utilize techniques such as recursive decoding and graph neural networks for encoding schemas.
The proposed model improves question match accuracy by 7% and interaction match accuracy by 11% over previous state-of-the-art methods.
